rca of the issue: Bug 1 RCA: The image-delete button on KB v2 card thumbnails had 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100' classes, making it invisible on touch devices / non-hover environments. Fix applied at KennisbankV2Page.js:1177 removed opacity classes and made it 'absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 rounded-full ... ring-1 ring-slate-900'. Verified via computed opacity=1 and visible red circles in screenshot. Bug 2 (admin grant UX): Inline form replaced by InputBark with variant='frame' triggered by single button. Verified ornamental frame opens and submits via grant() handler.
